scripts.start: npm run prepare:production && npm run smoke:backend && electron .
scripts.package:dir: npm run prepare:production && npm run smoke:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux dir
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:production && npm run smoke:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage
scripts.install:mac: SMIDR_UNSIGNED_MAC_BUILD=1 node scripts/build-macos.mjs dir && node scripts/install-macos.mjs
